_comment: MONEY-1489 — per-invocation EXECUTED-CASE floors, enforced by scripts/test-timeout.ts.
Full rationale in scripts/README.md; the short version:
CATCHES what nothing else can — cases that were never REGISTERED. MONEY-1093
shipped exactly that (an unquoted --test glob dropped 45 files / 3,093 cases)
and it exited 0 with every counter green.
KEY is '<workspace> <glob>' — @usemoney/core invokes the wrapper twice and one
floor across both globs would be met by either.
COUNTS pass + skipped, so an env-gated suite that legitimately skips on one
machine and runs on another does not turn the gate red.
RULE: below the floor fails; above is always free, so adding tests costs
nothing and only a DROP needs a deliberate edit here in the same commit. An
UNRECORDED key reports and does not fail — the wrapper prints a paste-ready
line for it on every run.
RE-MEASURE with `yarn turbo run test --concurrency=1` and read the
`[test-timeout] <key> — N cases …` lines. Measured on Node 22.22.
